memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, the 657-line build_contended_manifest() plus its three helpers build_sibling_territory(), _paths_contend(), and _sibling_territory_classify_entry() form one cleanly bounded 784-line territory-contention concern, independent of the rest of the file beyond lookup_project() and jq, and distinct from (builds on top of, does not duplicate) lib/file-scope-overlap.sh's path-matching primitives. This is the kind of unit worth checking for before assuming a large script must be decomposed function-by-function from scratch.

check-extension-docs.sh's Rule Q (check_undeclared_scripts, ~lines 530-580) already answers 'is this script registered in its owning manifest's provides.scripts' by full relative-path match. Any new probe needing that same check should shell out to check-extension-docs.sh and filter its FAIL lines rather than reimplementing the predicate, since that script is large (1,500+ lines) and multi-purpose.
